article.title: 하지만
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL Korean Basic Dictionary defines **하지만** as an adverb used to connect two sentences whose contents oppose one another. This entry is limited to that explicit contrastive function; it does not claim that 하지만 has every discourse use of 그런데 or that one Spanish translation fits every context.
